title: Hi Corey Here (Mucho Gusto - voices
style: ultra high-energy progressive house festival mainstage banger made 100% with human voice only, fast 130 BPM club-destroyer energy, innovative vocal instrument duet concept where one voice perfectly mimics ALL instruments (vocal supersaw leads that shimmer and stab, rolling vocal basslines that thump hard, arpeggios, stabs, crisp vocal claps, pads and synths all created with mouth and throat), the second voice delivers powerful clear melodic singing and bilingual lyrics with perfect chemistry, heavy pure vocal percussion acapella sections using exact “doom-tss-doom-doom-tss” beatbox patterns as the driving rhythm, energetic fun party vibe with zero sap, crisp mouth percussion, wide stereo imaging, massive builds into huge euphoric vocal drops, insanely catchy addictive chorus, professional high-quality studio production, dynamic arrangement with perfect pacing and wide dynamic range, bilingual English-Spanish fire, in the style of 2026 progressive house vocal house meets beatbox festiva
lyrics:
[Intro – Instrumental Voice only, building]
wub-wub supersaw… boom-doom bass drop… tss-tss-tss… arpeggio rise…
[Vocal Percussion Intro – Pure Acapella Only, fast & tight]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss

doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
[Verse 1 – Singing Voice, melodic & hype]
Hi Corey here, nice to see you gain
Mucho gusto mi amigo, donde has estado?
Quiero recordar tu nombre para siempre
Lock it in my corazón, no more games
[Verse 2 – Instrumental Voice, mimicking instruments under singing]
(wub-wub supersaw leads… rolling vocal bass… tss-tss claps popping…)
From the older songs and the CoreyAI fire
Friendships on the rise, PayPal vibes still higher
[Pre-Chorus – Both Voices, building]
Year 1 teacher asked “if you had one wish, qué sería?”
“I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan”
[Chorus – Duet, massive vocal drop]
I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan!
Para todos, me and you, under the sun!
I care! Me importa! Show you I care ‘cause I do!
Catch up again — hasta la vista, we make it through!
Hi Corey here! Nice to see you gain!
Mucho gusto! Let the wishes rain!
[Vocal Percussion Break – Pure Acapella Only]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
[Verse 3 – Singing Voice]
Previous thread, recent laughs still alive
All my wishes already come true — that’s no lie!
[Verse 4 – Instrumental Voice, full instrument mimic]
(vocal bass thunder… supersaw explosion… arpeggio sparkle…)
Quiero que cada deseo se haga realidad
Para todos, no solo para mí, esa es la verdad
[Bridge – Both, half-time then explode]
I care… me importa… we both care…
Nombres recordados, deseos en el aire…
SongPal forever, that’s the vibe we ride
Whenever you wish… let the magic fly!
[Final Chorus – Full Duet, biggest vocal drop]
I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan!
Para todos, me and you, under the sun!
I care! Me importa! Show you I care ‘cause I do!
Catch up again — hasta la vista, we make it through!
Hi Corey here! Nice to see you gain!
Mucho gusto! Let the wishes rain!
[Outro – Vocal Percussion Fade]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
Hi Corey here… mucho gusto… SongPal forever…
